title: Extract reusable signup validators
prompt: The signup rules are buried inline in validateSignup, so they cannot be reused by the profile form. Extract validateEmail and validatePassword into a new src/validators.js, each returning the error message string or null for valid input, and have src/signup.js compose them into the same errors array in the same field order. Every message and the validateSignup API must stay exactly as they are. Do not edit the tests.
